Text A. Our biggest models are a whale and a shark. We used blue paper to make the sea. The dolphin picture is the most popular with visitors. You can listen to sea sounds through headphones.

Text B. This is our quietest room. We made nests and tiny beetle models. The smallest model is a spider. Visitors can use a magnifying glass and write questions for our class.

Text C. We wrote funny stories about a donkey, a giraffe and a penguin. The giraffe story is the longest. Pupils read aloud at two. Visitors can borrow a storybook until Friday.
